run_compare_agents: run a 1v6 trial comparing one agent against six agents in a Diplomacy game
run_compare_agent_population: run a population trial comparing multiple agents assigned to different powers in Diplomacy
run_train: train a supervised learning strategy model using the provided configuration
run_benchmark_agent: benchmark a Diplomacy agent's performance using the benchmark tool
run_compute_xpower_statistics: compute xpower support statistics from game paths with an optional counterfactual agent
